name: El Carpio (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of yellow, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Carpio (quartered with wolves, bars, chequy and a tree).
history: Municipal flag of El Carpio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Carpio arms — quartered with wolves, bars, chequy and tree
